title: Resumable task publication
outcomes: A configured task publishes one verified version from its owned workspace, and resumes effects through exact readback without duplicate releases.

in: Explicit version/bump/changelog profiles, final candidate proof, scoped commit and serial integration, annotated Git tag/GitHub release publication, persisted effect intent/readback, managed release handoff and cleanup separation
out: Deployment/live endpoint adapters (abc-07), default migrations (abc-08), live model topology proof (abc-09/10)
boundaries: Trusted canonical controller, owned task workspace, declared Git remote and explicit GitHub repository

decision_rights: Authorize execution and choose model; GO on 2026-09-13
Implement bounded contract choices and document compatibility behavior

constraints: Require explicit push authorization from run/task execution authority; profile or model choice alone grants no publication rights. Freeze authority and profile for resume.

Extend readback profiles with an explicit publication contract for version source, semantic bump, tag prefix and changelog. Profiles without publication settings retain the existing release_pending gate.
Reserve the concrete version against exact current remote branch/tags under repository/channel coordination. Preserve user files; scope-check all preparation and staging.

Prepare version/changelog before final executed checks and critic. Content or contract changes invalidate proof; stale or diverged bases require explicit reconciliation rather than untested rebases or forced pushes.

Persist exact expected commit, annotated object, target and effect intent before commit/integration/push/publication. Reconcile actual readback after errors or lost responses; unknown observations stay pending. Never replace an existing conflicting tag/release.
Reuse workspace integration/execution locks and durable process guards. Freeze same task/run/owner/workspace; block live orphans and concurrent publication.

A delivery manifest links task/run, candidate/integration SHA, checks, critic, tag, publication and remote observations. Finish/approval use the existing strict completion gate; cleanup is independently resumable.
Retain historical profile/evidence meaning and legacy unconfigured behavior. No GitHub Actions or inferred deployment.

quality_attributes.scenario: Version preparation or integration changes candidate content
Lost acknowledgement after commit, integration, push, tag or publication
Concurrent controller or remote branch/tag update

risks: Readback must distinguish absent from unavailable; network or authorization failures are never absence.
External Git and GitHub cannot form one database transaction; durable intent and exact readback preserve pending state at every boundary.
